title: Jesus... Why Does An Empty Room Feel This Loud? 😔
topic: her roommate moved out this morning with two suitcases and one long hug, and the room feels loud tonight

bible.text: For if one falls down, his companion can lift him up; but pity the one who falls without another to help him up!

lines.text: Jesus... why does an empty room feel this loud? 😔

lines.text: Anitha moved out this morning. Two suitcases. One hug that lasted too long.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You're not missing the room. You're missing being known at 11pm.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Everyone says we'll stay in touch. We always say that.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Some friendships don't end. They just get a new address.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Text her tonight. Not about the room. Just ‘I'm in a quieter one now.’

lines.text: Who still feels close after moving away? 👇
